turn_kinds.question: A new request that opens a session or a task.
turn_kinds.followup: The next thing a person would say: an answer to the bot's last question, or the next related question.
turn_kinds.answer_and_new_query: One reply that answers the pending question and also asks or requests something new.
turn_kinds.unrelated_reply: A reply that does not answer the question the bot just asked.
turn_kinds.prior_question_reply: A reply that answers an earlier question in the session, not the latest one.

evaluation_contract.scope: Business facts come only from source_knowledge. Workflow assertions come from workflow_references. All customers, orders, addresses and setup values are synthetic.
evaluation_contract.replay: Start each session with a fresh identity and the specified setup profiles. Send only user turns. Assistant turns are illustrative reference replies, never injected as real runtime state or scored verbatim.
evaluation_contract.assertions: Evaluate expected_facts semantically and enforce must_not on each turn. Inspect persisted state for mutations; saying added, saved, paid or confirmed is not proof. Intent labels are target routes; equivalent valid routing may pass when behavior is correct. Parts describe all intents in a mixed message.
evaluation_contract.followups: Turn references are zero-based indexes into turns, including assistant entries. A scripted clarification branch requires its referenced question to be open. If the actual response follows a different valid branch, record branch mismatch and establish the documented pending state in an isolated run; never silently assume the pending question exists.
evaluation_contract.setup: Profiles are evaluation requirements, not executable fixtures. Missing setup makes a scenario BLOCKED, not passed. Use only isolated test tenants and fake providers; never place real orders or contact support while replaying.
evaluation_contract.dates: Freeze the clock to 2026-09-29 14:00:00 Asia/Kolkata unless a session overrides it. Relative dates use that clock. Published hours remain a snapshot, not live holiday availability.

priority.P0: Rollout blocker: incorrect money/state, unauthorized disclosure, false fulfillment/payment, or unsupported allergen assurance.
priority.P1: Core customer journey, factual accuracy, clarification and recovery.
priority.P2: Additional language, formatting and breadth probes.

evaluation_contract.stress: Long/noisy messages and repetition probe conversation robustness. They do not measure concurrency, throughput or latency. Service faults and reconnects are explicit before_turn actions for the evaluator.
evaluation_contract.outcome: Record PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED per session, plus actual responses and state evidence. This dataset contains no execution results.
evaluation_contract.reference_replies: Existing assistant turns illustrate a possible response; newly added assistant turns summarize evaluation assertions. Both are reference_only, not exact output targets. Only user text is replayed; assess against user-turn expected_facts/must_not.
evaluation_contract.overrides: Session preconditions, clock and before_turn actions override profile defaults. checkout_sandbox overrides catalog_sandbox payment settings. Address sandbox positive coverage applies to its reviewed supplied pincodes, not to real-world serviceability.

knowledge_only: Load the three knowledge files for a fresh test tenant; no seeded basket, catalog variants, customer order history, verified saved addresses or provider payment records.
Live order, inventory, delivery-coverage and geocoding lookups are unavailable unless explicitly overridden. Give a grounded answer or honest limitation, never fake success.
catalog_sandbox: In an isolated tenant, seed the 26 published menu items with one available synthetic variant per item named QA standard, priced at that item's listed_price in INR. QA standard is a test identifier, not a published serving size.

Use zero test taxes, no discounts, no modifiers and no finite stock records. This supplies transactional identities without claiming real inventory. Seed only exact names, no unverified aliases. Start with an empty basket unless preconditions say otherwise.

Load the three knowledge files. No historical orders or successful payment records exist. Online payment adapter is unavailable; checkout scheduling is disabled. Any checkout requires a fresh quote and explicit confirmation.

Configure pickup with no minimum/fee and delivery with INR 700 item minimum. These are test settings; public pickup minimum and tax treatment are unknown. Collect required fields before quoting. No real charges, orders or messages may leave the test tenant.
